answer.reason: JDG 8:27 states what was made of the ephod and what happened through it.

clauses.english: was made by Gideon from the gold of the spoil and set up in Ophrah
clauses.quote: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah

clauses.english: became a snare to Gideon and his house when all Israel went after it
clauses.quote: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house
